newsitem.title: USA: Ampex says court overturns $8.1 mln award.
newsitem.headline: Ampex says court overturns $8.1 mln award.

text.p: Ampex Corp said Wednesday the U.S. District Court for the District of Delaware granted a post-trial motion from Mitsubishi Electric Corp to set aside an earlier jury verdict for Mitsubishi to pay $8.1 million in damages to Ampex.
A jury in April awarded Ampex $8.1 million in a suit in which Ampex alleged that Mitsubishi's picture-in-a-picture feature infringed on an Ampex patent.
Ampex said Wednesday evening in a statement that it will appeal the latest decision to set aside the award.
"Ampex is planning to appeal this judgment or to move for a retrial," the company statement said.
